1.steps:
1) Go to Network > Interfaces page.
2) Click to edit an interface.
3) On Advanced Tab select port Redundancy and port from drop downs.
4) Click OK.
1.title: Configuration of Redundant Port
1.result: Interface now shows the redundant port in its configuration. Redundant interface is not editable.

2.steps:
1) Go to Network > Interfaces page.
2) Click to edit an interface.
3) On Advanced Tab select Nonefrom drop down.
4) Click OK.
2.initial:
PC on LAN.
Server on WAN.
Redundant interface already configured.
2.title: Removing Redundant Port
2.result: Interface does not show redundant port in its configuration. Interface that was redundant port can now be edited.
